reviewBulk.jobsPage.deleted.description: Success notification after a job is deleted. {jobId} is the job ID.

reviewBulk.jobsPage.descriptionAdmin.defaultMessage: Bulk Skip All Reviews runs by every user.
reviewBulk.jobsPage.descriptionAdmin.description: Description under the Jobs heading for an Admin, who sees every user's jobs.

reviewBulk.jobsPage.descriptionOwn.defaultMessage: Your bulk Skip All Reviews runs.
reviewBulk.jobsPage.descriptionOwn.description: Description under the Jobs heading for a Reviewer, who sees only their own jobs.

reviewBulk.jobsPage.emptyDescription.defaultMessage: Bulk Skip All Reviews runs that go to the background appear here.
reviewBulk.jobsPage.emptyDescription.description: Description of the empty state of the Jobs table.

reviewBulk.jobsPage.emptyTitle.description: Title of the empty state of the Jobs table.

reviewBulk.jobsPage.find.description: Placeholder and screen-reader label of the text filter of the Jobs table.

reviewBulk.jobsPage.loadFailed.description: Header of the error alert when the job list cannot be loaded.

reviewBulk.jobsPage.loadJobsAction.description: Action phrase completing an API error sentence ("Failed to …: <error>" / "You do not have permission to …") when the job list cannot be loaded.

reviewBulk.jobsPage.loading.description: Loading text of the Jobs table.

reviewBulk.jobsPage.pageSize.description: Title of the page size choice in the Jobs table settings.

reviewBulk.jobsPage.pageSizeOption.description: A page size option in the Jobs table settings. {count} is the number of jobs per page.

reviewBulk.jobsPage.preferences.description: Title of the Jobs table settings dialog.

reviewBulk.jobsPage.processedOfTotal.description: Cell of the Processed / Total column. {processed} is the number of documents done, {total} the number the job applies to.

reviewBulk.jobsPage.refresh.description: Screen-reader label of the refresh button of the Jobs table.

reviewBulk.jobsPage.resourceName.description: Name of one item of the Jobs table, used by its empty state.

reviewBulk.jobsPage.retry.description: Button in the error alert that loads the job list again.

reviewBulk.jobsPage.stalled.description: Status badge next to a job status when the job has not reported progress for 30 minutes.

reviewBulk.jobsPage.title.description: Heading of the Jobs page table.

reviewBulk.outcomeCounts.count.description: One outcome count of a bulk Skip All Reviews run or Send to review. {label} is the outcome (e.g. "Skipped"), {count} the number of documents.

reviewBulk.outcomeCounts.noDocuments.description: Shown instead of the outcome counts of a bulk Skip All Reviews run or Send to review when no document has an outcome.

reviewBulk.outcomeCounts.willBeSkipped.description: Outcome label in the dry-run preview of bulk Skip All Reviews: the reviews that the run will skip.

reviewBulk.reviewMenu.releaseReview.description: Review menu item of the Document List (Admin) that releases the claims on the selected documents' reviews.

reviewBulk.reviewMenu.releaseReviewDisab.defaultMessage: Select documents with a claimed review
reviewBulk.reviewMenu.releaseReviewDisab.description: Why the Release Review menu item is disabled: no selected document has a claimed review.

reviewBulk.reviewMenu.sendSelected.description: Review menu item that sends the selected finished documents to the Default review queue. {count} is the number of selected documents it applies to.

reviewBulk.reviewMenu.skipProfile.description: Review menu item that opens bulk Skip All Reviews by configuration profile and submitted dates.

reviewBulk.reviewMenu.skipSelected.description: Review menu item that skips the pending reviews of the selected documents. {count} is the number of selected documents it applies to.

reviewBulk.reviewMenu.startReview.description: Review menu item of the Document List that claims the selected documents' pending reviews.

reviewBulk.reviewMenu.startReviewDisable.defaultMessage: Select documents with an unclaimed pending review
reviewBulk.reviewMenu.startReviewDisable.description: Why the Start Review menu item is disabled: no selected document has an unclaimed pending review.

reviewBulk.sendToReviewModal.body.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {This document} other {These # documents}} will be added to the Default review queue. Reviewers see your reason with the item; completing the review reprocesses the document with their edits.
reviewBulk.sendToReviewModal.body.description: Explanation in the Send to review dialog. {count} is the number of documents being sent; "Default review queue" is the name of the queue.

reviewBulk.sendToReviewModal.confirm.description: Confirm button of the Send to review dialog.

reviewBulk.sendToReviewModal.failed.description: Error in the Send to review dialog when the request fails. {error} is the error message from the server.

reviewBulk.sendToReviewModal.header.description: Title of the dialog that puts finished documents into the Default review queue.

reviewBulk.sendToReviewModal.noSelection.defaultMessage: Select finished documents that are not in review
reviewBulk.sendToReviewModal.noSelection.description: Why the Send to review confirm button is disabled: no selected document can be sent.

reviewQueues.queuePage.adminDescription.defaultMessage: Select items to assign them to an Annotator or unassign them. More actions moves them to another queue, removes them from the queues or skips their reviews. Edit opens an item without changing its assignment.
reviewQueues.queuePage.adminDescription.description: Description under the Items table header of a review queue, for an Admin. "More actions" and "Edit" name the table's menu and row action.

reviewQueues.queuePage.moreActions.description: Menu button in the header of a review queue's Items table, holding the queue and skip actions for the selected items.

reviewQueues.queuePage.move.description: More actions item that moves the selected items to another review queue (opens a dialog). The count of selected items is appended in parentheses.

reviewQueues.queuePage.noOtherQueue.description: Why the Move… item is disabled: there is no other review queue to move items to.

reviewQueues.queuePage.queueGroup.description: Group heading in the More actions menu of a review queue: moving or removing the selected items.

reviewQueues.queuePage.removeFromQueue.description: More actions item that takes the selected items out of the review queues (opens a dialog). The count of removable items is appended in parentheses.

reviewQueues.queuePage.selectToMove.description: Why the Move… item is disabled: no item is selected.

reviewQueues.queuePage.selectToRemove.defaultMessage: Select items waiting for review or assigned
reviewQueues.queuePage.selectToRemove.description: Why the Remove from queue… item is disabled: no selected item is waiting for review or assigned.

reviewQueues.queuePage.skipAllReviews.description: More actions item that skips all reviews of the selected items. The count of skippable items is appended in parentheses.

reviewQueues.queuePage.skipByProfile.description: More actions item that opens the dialog to skip all reviews of the documents matching a profile (filters).

reviewQueues.queuePage.skipGroup.description: Group heading in the More actions menu of a review queue: skipping the reviews of documents.

reviewQueues.queuePage.skipJobStarted.defaultMessage: Skip All Reviews is running as a background job.
reviewQueues.queuePage.skipJobStarted.description: Success notification when a bulk Skip All Reviews started as a background job; the page then opens the job.

reviewQueues.queuePage.skipResultsHeader.description: Header of the dialog listing the per-document outcomes of a bulk Skip All Reviews that ran inline.

reviewQueues.taskContext.sentBy.description: Body of the Sent to review alert. {requestedBy} is the user (e-mail) who sent the document to review.

reviewQueues.taskContext.sentByWithNote.description: Body of the Sent to review alert when the sender left a note. {requestedBy} is the user (e-mail) who sent it; {note} is their free-text note.

reviewQueues.taskContext.sentToReview.description: Header of the info alert on a review task whose document was sent to review by hand. {reason} is the reason chosen when sending it.

routes.myWork.jobCrumb.description: Last breadcrumb on the page of one bulk Skip All Reviews job, after Home › Jobs.
